why: UTS #39 section 3.1.1.1 (rules A2 and B) and RFC 5892 CONTEXTJ allow a joiner right after a virama that sits on a letter, and Malayalam text written before Unicode 5.1 ends a word with the legacy chillu, consonant plus virama plus ZWJ, before a space. The pass side is docs/ml.md with that word-final chillu in prose, plus an AGENTS.md with the Sinhala conjunct SHA, AL-LAKUNA, ZWJ, RA, II, where a letter of the same script follows the joiner. The fail side is an AGENTS.md whose legacy chillu is followed by a space and a Latin letter. Without the exemption the pass side goes red; extending it to a word-final joiner in agent files turns the fail side green.
